title: play_character_from_province
description:
The active player plays a character from one of their provinces during the play cards from provinces step.

The player says what they pay, since card effects may modify costs: `card_cost` for the card, `fate_cost` for the additional fate, and `fate` is the number of fate placed on the character. Refilling the province and ending the opportunity to act are separate actions of the player.

card_id.description: Face-up character in a province of the player.

fate_cost.description: Fate paid for the additional fate placed on the character.
